_meta.title: CHANI App Content Logic — Natal Placements, Aspects, and Transits
_meta.purpose: Reverse-engineered generation logic for how the CHANI app composes and prioritizes natal placement readings, gift/challenge aspects, and transit themes.
_meta.source: Derived from 42 in-app screenshots (Me / birth chart and Transits tabs).
_meta.voice: Second person, warm, embodied, practical. Challenges reframed constructively. Astrology named plainly but never jargon-forward.

natal_placement_page.description: Each planet or point gets its own page, assembled from stacked layers in a fixed order. Layers 3-5 are conditional.

layer_order.content: How the body's core FUNCTION expresses through the SIGN's style/archetype. This is the personality/temperament layer.
layer_order.example_gist: Sun (identity/will) + Aquarius (disruptor/intellectual) = 'You want to create things that disrupt the status quo.'

layer_order.content: How that function plays out in a CONCRETE domain of life. House supplies a domain label-set.
layer_order.example_header: ... in the 9th house of travel, education, publishing, religion, astrology and philosophy

house_life_areas.9: travel, education, publishing, religion, astrology, philosophy
house_life_areas.12: the unseen, endings, solitude, the imaginal

layer_order.conditional: Only rendered for the chart's SECT LIGHT (the dominant luminary).

logic.day_chart: If born during the day (Sun above horizon), the Sun is the sect light / 'light leader'. Its team (helped-by planets) = Jupiter and Saturn (diurnal sect). These three take precedence.
logic.night_chart: If born at night (Sun below horizon), the Moon is the sect light. Its team = Venus and Mars (nocturnal sect).
logic.mercury: Mercury is flexible — joins whichever sect it is closer to / rises with.
logic.consequence: The sect light and its team are the highest-priority planets for interpretation AND for weighting which transits matter most.

layer_order.example: The Sun is your light leader ... the planets to pay close attention to are Jupiter and Saturn, as they are on the Sun's 'team'.

layer_order.conditional: Only if the natal body was retrograde at birth.
layer_order.header: {Body} was retrograde when you were born.
layer_order.content: Adds an internalized / re- (revisit, review, revise) theme to the body's expression.
layer_order.example: With your natal Saturn retrograde, you will tend to revisit, review, and revise your work, your expectations, and your limits over time.

layer_order.conditional: Woven into prose when the body sits in a sign of dignity or debility.
layer_order.content: Reference domicile / exaltation / detriment / fall to raise or qualify the reading's confidence.
layer_order.example: Aquarius is Saturn's air domicile, which lends you a talent for orchestrating systems.

layer_order.content: All aspects the focal body makes to other bodies/points, split into two buckets (Gifts, then Challenges). See aspect_classification.

aspect_classification.description: Every aspect to the focal body is sorted into GIFTS or CHALLENGES. Classification is a function of (aspect type) x (nature of the OTHER body).

card_format.body: Short second-person paragraph blending: focal body's domain (its sign/house) + other body's significations + the aspect's ease or tension.
card_format.note: Aspects are reciprocal — the same pair appears on BOTH bodies' pages (e.g., 'MC CONJUNCT SUN' on the Sun page and 'SUN CONJUNCT MC' on the MC page).

rules: TRINE or SEXTILE -> GIFTS (almost always, regardless of the other body).
CONJUNCTION -> takes the nature of the OTHER body: conjunct a benefic/luminary/angle -> GIFTS; conjunct a malefic -> CHALLENGES.
SQUARE or OPPOSITION -> CHALLENGES by default.
OVERRIDE: a BENEFIC (Venus/Jupiter) in a hard aspect can be filed under GIFTS, framed as a gift-with-tension (e.g., Jupiter opposing Sun sits under the Sun's Gifts).
NORTH NODE conjunctions follow a growth frame and lean by the focal body: to a malefic -> Challenges; to a luminary -> aspirational/Gift.
aspect_classification.ordering_within_bucket: Appears to follow a body sequence (personal/luminaries & angles -> social -> outer -> points) or aspect-orb tightness. Exact rule not fully determinable from screenshots; recommend ordering by tightest orb, then by traditional body order.

short_term.window: hours to ~1 week (Moon ~a day; inner planets a few days).

long_term.retrograde_multipass: When the transiting planet is retrograde, the aspect perfects up to 3 times; the window widens and the app labels which pass it is (e.g., '2nd of 3 times').

transits.transit_definition: A transit = {transiting_body} {aspect} {natal_point}. Targets include planets, angles (Ascendant/MC), nodes, and asteroids (e.g., Pallas Athena) — the whole natal chart is eligible.

card_anatomy.1_title: Creative theme headline in CAPS — evokes the felt experience or the advice, NOT the astrology. e.g., DEEP BREATH, WINNING STRATEGY, DIRECT MESSAGE, THE BOLDER THE BETTER, REST IS ROMANTIC, CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER.
card_anatomy.3_body: Second-person, practical, actionable. Hard transits reframed constructively ('It's not a bad thing, just something to be aware of'); flowing transits say 'make the most of it'.
card_anatomy.4_the_astro: Footer line revealing the mechanic LAST: 'The astro: {transiting_body} {aspect} your {natal_point}'. Retrograde noted here if applicable.

valence_framing.trine_sextile: ease, flow, opportunity — 'things work out, make the most of it'.
valence_framing.square_opposition: friction, growth, caution — name the tension, then give constructive direction.
valence_framing.conjunction: intensification colored by the transiting planet's nature (Mars conj ASC = energized/confrontational; Jupiter conj Jupiter = milestone/return; North Node conj Sun = destiny/boldness).

prioritization_logic: First split by planet speed (short vs long-term sections).
Weight transits to your SECT LIGHT and its team (from the natal importance layer) and to personal points/angles most heavily.
Anchor and order by the EXACT (partile) date; a transit becomes 'active' as it approaches exactness.
Slow outer-planet transits (Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto to a personal point) are the highest-significance long-term themes; retrograde multi-pass increases their weight and dwell time.
Each transit inherits its valence from the same aspect x body-nature logic used for natal gifts/challenges.
